scope: Three previously admitted historical identities; thirteen quest-completion components, six level/era display components, three category associations and three category ancestry rows. No guessed modern definition is added.

metadata_origin.definition_ids_icons_points_and_exact_st: Preserved current admitted resource-derived catalogue, byte-equal to the original Steppes audit. These numeric/display fields are not independently authenticated as a May2013 client definition dump.
metadata_origin.period_proven: Achievement semantic identities, Progression versus Advancement category membership, and all thirteen completion quest names/order are corroborated by pre-cutoff archived parent pages and individual task pages.
metadata_origin.not_inferred: has_reward is a raw metadata hint, not a reward ID or grant. Level/era display rows do not create new completion criteria. No quest/achievement/reward activation in this file.

installation: After required achievement schema/reward-class migration and shared-run occurrence table; before disabled Steppes task/content SQL. Existing exact rows remain untouched, including enabled/version/profile state; missing definitions inserted disabled. No category subtree replacement.
